data.change_summary: All acceptance criteria for organism death → detritus routing are already fully implemented. Shrimp death routing exists in shrimp.rs:626-656 (route_dead_shrimp_to_detritus), plant senescence routing in plant_growth.rs:387-389 (route_plant_loss_to_fine_detritus), and algae death routing in algae_growth.rs:277-279 (route_algae_loss_to_fine_detritus). The death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction parameter (default 1.0) exists in process.rs:218. Body composition constants are documented in budget.rs:5-35 (ADULT_SHRIMP_BIOMASS_G, JUVENILE_SHRIMP_BIOMASS_G, SHRIMP_N_MG_PER_G_WET_MASS, SHRIMP_C_MG_PER_G_WET_MASS, PLANT_N_MG_PER_G_BIOMASS, ALGAE_N_MG_PER_G_BIOMASS, LIVE_BIOMASS_ORGANIC_FRACTION_G_PER_G). All required unit and integration tests exist in budget_tracking.rs and shrimp_feeding_pathway.rs. Full test suite passes (0 failures), clippy clean.
outstanding_risks: The shrimp body mass N:C ratio uses feed_n_to_c_ratio (0.16) rather than a shrimp-specific body composition ratio. This is a simplification noted in the code — shrimp tissue may have a different N:C than feed. A future refinement could add a shrimp_body_n_to_c_ratio parameter.

Phosphorus is not explicitly tracked in detritus pools. When detritus dissolves, P is released at a fixed FEED_P_TO_N_MASS_RATIO (0.10) which may not match actual organism tissue P:N ratios. This is an existing system-wide limitation, not specific to this bead.

Mortality probability is clamped at 0.5 per daily step, so even with base_mortality=1.0, not all shrimp die in a single step. The test at line 1163 accounts for this but it means mass extinction scenarios play out over multiple days.

steps.description: Verified shrimp death → detritus routing: route_dead_shrimp_to_detritus() at shrimp.rs:626-656 converts dead_count × body_mass → fine_detritus_g_total using live_biomass_detrital_mass_g() with N+C accounting. Reserve pool is proportionally transferred. death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction (1.0) gates the transfer with a debug_assert enforcing Phase 1 invariant.

Verified plant senescence → detritus routing: route_plant_loss_to_fine_detritus() at plant_growth.rs:387-389 uses plant_detrital_mass_g() which sums plant_nitrogen_mg() + plant_carbon_mg() / 1000 → fine_detritus_g_total. Senescence is amplified by poor health_index. Loss is clamped to available biomass via clamp_partitioned_losses(). Both N and C are properly routed.

Verified algae death → detritus routing: route_algae_loss_to_fine_detritus() at algae_growth.rs:277-279 uses algae_detrital_mass_g() which sums algae_nitrogen_mg() + algae_carbon_mg() / 1000 → fine_detritus_g_total. Both suspended algae (respiration + grazing losses) and periphyton (respiration + grazing + excess capacity losses) are routed. Both N and C properly accounted.

Verified death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction parameter exists at process.rs:218 with default 1.0, serde-enabled for future schema evolution. Documentation in the field comment explains Phase 1 fixed-at-1.0 rationale.

Verified body composition parameters are named and documented in budget.rs:5-35: ADULT_SHRIMP_BIOMASS_G=0.12, JUVENILE_SHRIMP_BIOMASS_G=0.05, LIVE_BIOMASS_ORGANIC_FRACTION_G_PER_G=0.20, SHRIMP_N_MG_PER_G_WET_MASS≈27.6, SHRIMP_C_MG_PER_G_WET_MASS≈172.4, PLANT_N_MG_PER_G_BIOMASS=28.0, ALGAE_N_MG_PER_G_BIOMASS=35.0. Literature validation notes are included in doc comments.

Verified unit test: test_shrimp_death_routes_body_mass_to_detritus_and_conserves_n_c() at budget_tracking.rs:1071 — kills shrimp under high stress, verifies detritus increases and total N/C conserved within 1e-6. Additionally test_shrimp_death_detritus_amount_matches_expected_body_mass() at line 1104 verifies exact detritus amounts match dead_count × body_mass.

Verified unit test: test_plant_loss_routing_is_clamped_to_available_biomass_and_stays_particulate() at budget_tracking.rs:544 — sets extreme respiration+senescence rates to kill all plant biomass, verifies total N/C conserved within 1e-6 and detritus increases. Also test_trim_plants_preserves_n_and_c_when_routed_to_detritus() at line 577.

Verified unit test: test_algae_loss_routing_is_clamped_to_available_biomass_and_stays_particulate() at budget_tracking.rs:509 — sets extreme respiration rate with high grazing to kill all algae biomass, verifies total N/C conserved within 1e-6 and detritus increases.

Verified integration test: test_high_mortality_200_hours_conserves_n_c_and_accumulates_detritus() at budget_tracking.rs:1187 — runs 200 hours (8×25h blocks) with high temperature (33°C), elevated ammonia, low DO, active microbes. Checks N/C conservation at each 25-hour checkpoint (tolerance <0.5mg) and verifies population decline.
Ran full test suite: all tests pass (0 failures across all crates). Ran cargo clippy: no warnings. No code changes needed — all acceptance criteria were already implemented.
